description: Aalto University and collaborating researchers publish MATLAB code and data comparing optimisation formulations for reactively loaded antenna arrays. The January 2025 Zenodo release and linked repository state CC BY 4.0 and free access. The README identifies compute_terminations.m as the entry script for optimising loads using three formulations, plotting figures and exporting results. It requires MATLAB RF Toolbox, Manopt 7.1 and CVX; matlab2tikz is optional for figure export. The code can compare design methods for array components in communication-system simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this implementation. Coverage is a computational design experiment, not an observed network or historical period. Exact example geometry, frequency, objective definitions and numerical tolerances were not established from the README. Free source access does not include the required commercial MATLAB environment. The archive was not downloaded, solvers were not run and the reported design comparison was not independently reproduced.
